independent_solution: Each leg is 500 m; after every leg the heading turns 60 deg left, so leg k points at 60(k-1) deg and six legs close a regular hexagon of side 500 m.
Third turn (3 legs): R = 500[(1,0) + (0.5,0.866) + (-0.5,0.866)] = (500, 866) m -> |R| = 1000 m at 60 deg to the initial direction; path 1.5 km.
Sixth turn: closed hexagon, R = 0, path 3 km. Eighth turn = second vertex again: R = (750, 433) m -> 866 m (= 500 sqrt3) at 30 deg; path 4 km. In each case |R| < path length.
questions.independent_answer: 3rd turn: 1 km at 60 deg to the initial direction (path 1.5 km); 6th: null displacement (path 3 km); 8th: 866 m at 30 deg (path 4 km).
questions.official_answer: Displacement of magnitude 1 km and direction 60 deg with the initial direction; path 1.5 km (third turn); null displacement, path 3 km (sixth turn); 866 m, 30 deg, 4 km (eighth turn)

independent_solution: Full options read on pinned page 4. |A+B|^2 = A^2 + B^2 + 2AB cos(theta); |A-B|^2 = A^2 + B^2 - 2AB cos(theta).
Equal iff AB cos(theta) = 0: A perpendicular to B, or A = 0 or B = 0. Equal magnitudes alone do not suffice ((a) fails at theta = 0; (c) parallel gives 2A vs 0).

findings.detail: answer.check is wrong physics: '|A + B| = |A - B| ... happens only for perpendicular vectors of equal size'. |A+B| = |A-B| holds for perpendicular vectors of any magnitudes (|A+B|^2 - |A-B|^2 = 4AB cos(theta)), as this package's own Q-PHY-MIP-05-EXEMPLAR-4-15 answer shows. Drop 'of equal size' (e.g. 'which happens exactly when A and B are perpendicular').
